AC6 LANDED. Gerrit change 2549 MERGED (LLM-Review +1, Verified +1, submitted by RebarBotNava). `infra/runbooks/gerrit-host-wedged-ssm-lost.md` is now on main, plus a cross-reference from review-bot-ops.md's disk-full section pointing operators to the shell-free sibling when SSM is ConnectionLost.

Note on the review cycle, recorded because it is a reusable trap: the first `LLM-Review -1` was cleared by earning this ticket's plan-review attestation, but re-pushing with `git commit --amend --no-edit` produced a patch set Gerrit classified as NO_CODE_CHANGE, and the copy condition CARRIED THE -1 FORWARD instead of triggering a re-review. An empty amend does not re-trigger the review bot. Patch set 3 carried a real content change (the review-bot-ops.md cross-reference) and drew a fresh PASS.

## Where this ticket stands

DONE: AC3 (measured consumer breakdown), AC6 (runbook, landed). Defect 2's code fix was already on main and is verified present.
REWRITTEN: AC2, against measured reality — the original premise was refuted.
OWNED ELSEWHERE: AC4 (bounded ceiling) and AC5 (/var/gerrit) belong to epic `6202-e1c7-c57f-4897` (endowed-upset-scaup), which is open, linked, and still has NO CHILDREN — it needs decomposition.
BLOCKED ON AN OPERATOR ACTION: AC1's second half (an induced publish-stop raising the alarm) is a live production test, and AC2's replay is already satisfied analytically but its post-change confirmation is operational.

## Still awaiting an operator decision

1. AC5's default — finish `scowlful-bovine-dragonfly` or fold it into this ticket. The plan-review gate independently flagged this (E2 advisory) as a real choice left to the executor.
2. Whether ALERT FATIGUE becomes its own tracked work item. The evidence on this ticket now shows 11 delivered, SNS-actioned pages in 24h with no action, and 3h33m of continuous ALARM before the outage. That is the dominant cause and nothing currently owns it.
